notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Mnemonic Wall.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
